verdict.text: Fails to launch when built with the iOS 27 SDK.

findings.title: No scene configuration
findings.message: Info.plist has no UIApplicationSceneManifest, and AppDelegate does not implement application(_:configurationForConnecting:options:). Built with the iOS 27 SDK, the app stops at launch: "UIScene life cycle is required for apps built with this SDK".

fix.title: Upgrade to React Native 0.88
steps: React Native 0.88 is stable (0.88.0 on npm since 15 October 2026; release post of 19 October 2026) and supports the UIScene life cycle without breaking the AppDelegate path. 0.87.1 and earlier have no scene support, and the React Native team will not backport it.

Move the React Native entry point from AppDelegate to a SceneDelegate (RCTReactNativeFactory's new startReactNativeWithModuleName:inWindow:connectionOptions:), forward the scene's URL and user-activity callbacks to RCTLinkingManager, and add UIApplicationSceneManifest to Info.plist. The 0.88 template and the upgrade helper show the change in SceneDelegate.swift and Info.plist.

Keep UIApplicationSupportsMultipleScenes false: 0.88 supports one scene, and at launch it forwards only the first URL context or user activity. The window can be resized; Dimensions.get() and useWindowDimensions() follow it.

sources.title: React Native 0.88 release post (iOS: SceneDelegate support)
react/react-native#58545: closed with the fix in 0.88 and no backport

alternatives.title: Add a SceneDelegate by hand
steps: Port the 0.88 template's SceneDelegate and Info.plist manifest to your version: create the window from the UIWindowScene and start React Native into it there.
Before 0.88, startReactNative takes launch options, not connection options, so convert the connection options of a link that launches the app.
The React Native team gives deep links through the scene delegate and Dimensions for a resizable window as the reasons it does not backport 0.88's change; check both in your port.

Apple: Transitioning to the UIKit scene-based life cycle

findings.title: Window created in the app delegate
findings.message: AppDelegate creates the window with UIWindow(frame:). With a scene, UIKit does not show a window that belongs to no scene, and the app opens to a black screen.
